name: Inspiring Melody
description: Play an inspiring tune that increases party damage.

name: Soothing Song
description: Sing a gentle song that heals allies over time.

name: Battle Hymn
description: A powerful war song that boosts attack speed.

name: Discordant Note
description: Strike a jarring note that damages and confuses enemies.

name: Charm Person
description: Use your charisma to charm a humanoid temporarily.

name: Lullaby
description: Sing enemies to sleep.

name: Countersong
description: Counter enemy magical effects with your performance.

name: Cutting Words
description: Distract an enemy, reducing their effectiveness.

name: Thunderous Crescendo
description: Build to a powerful crescendo that stuns enemies.

name: Dirge of Doom
description: Play a mournful dirge that weakens all enemies.

name: Song of Rest
description: Play restful music that enhances regeneration out of combat.

name: Song of Heroism
description: Inspire an ally to perform beyond their limits.

name: Cacophony
description: Create overwhelming noise that damages all nearby enemies.

name: Hymn of Restoration
description: A holy hymn that heals all party members.

name: Fascinate
description: Captivate enemies with your performance.

name: Ghostly Chorus
description: Summon spectral voices to sing with you.

name: Rallying Anthem
description: Shout an anthem that removes fear and charm effects.

name: Blade Dance
description: Perform a dance with your blade, striking multiple times.

name: Finale
description: End your performance with a powerful burst of magic.

name: Encore
description: Repeat your last song at reduced effectiveness.
